from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single company's financial profit data extracted from one document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company reported in the document")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock ticker code if provided in the document")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The specific reporting period (e.g., 2024 Q1)")
    total_profit: float | None = Field(description="The total profit amount extracted, normalized to the base currency")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit of the profit value (e.g., CNY, RMB)")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim text snippet anchoring the profit figure and label")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_records: list[CompanyFinancialRecord]
